verdict.rationale: A cloud backend platform could fairly state or offer controls over whether customer data is used for AI model training, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no such policy, opt-out, or contractual commitment. Self-hosting and data-location control (appwrite-docs-24) and compliance badges (SOC-2, HIPAA) are adjacent privacy features, not a documented training opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
